inputs.text: Calling the “No Kings” protest “chaos” shifts attention away from the state’s response: federal officers used tear gas and made arrests, with at least 13 confirmed in Portland and Denver. Dismissing demonstrators as “agitators” is a familiar tactic for making dissent seem illegitimate while shielding official force from scrutiny. When people challenging power face intimidation and arrest, the consequences fall on everyone’s right to protest. Democracy requires protecting dissent, not suppressing it.
